name: King Gatoria
source:
The father of Prince Marion, the king of Gatria.
In front of the prince, he is a childish father, but in reality he is aggressive, short-tempered and pushy, so-called "dictator".
He believes that the strong are always right, and tries to solve everything with force and power.
He is also a strategist, plotting to seize supremacy on the peninsula and manipulating war from the shadows.

By the way, the owner of the idea that "a woman is something to take", the queen is in a state of transition. It feels like this parent and this child ant.
